summary: Choose what launchpad sets up, change any answer, and see what usage-priced tools really cost for your app.
notes: See everything launchpad sets up and switch any of it off; what depended on it goes too, and your privacy policy and Apple's answers follow.
Every answer stays editable: go back to any question and change it, and Mission Control updates everything that depended on it.
No domain yet? Pick from names that are actually free, each with a Buy button.
Usage-priced tools show a realistic monthly estimate for your app, in minutes and dollars, behind a small info button.
A shorter first reply in onboarding, cards with direct links, and the update window helps when Claude Code is missing launchpad's marketplace.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
